profile.headline: Software Engineer | C++, Java, Scala, C#.Net, Node.js, React, Angular
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer | Cloud & Platform Specialist | Builder of Better Dev Experiences

I turn big ideas into scalable, reliable code, then automate everything so the next release ships twice as fast.

For 10+ years I’ve designed and delivered enterprise-scale services for names you know (Electronic Arts, Disney), crafting microservice and serverless architectures that handle 50 M+ daily transactions without breaking a sweat. My sweet spot is where platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud architecture intersect:

Cloud-Native Problem Solver: From Java/Spring APIs to AWS Lambda pipelines, I build the glue that keeps content flowing and players (or customers) happy. If the solution isn’t obvious, you’ll find me diagramming dependencies, spiking prototypes, and turning “we can’t” into “ship it.”

Automation Champion: CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions? Terraform/CDK IaC? Observability dashboards in Grafana and CloudWatch? Yes, yes, and absolutely. I love removing manual steps almost as much as I love good coffee.

Hands-On Leader & Mentor: I’ve onboarded junior devs, led cross-functional pods, and written the design docs that become team standards. My goal: grow people, not just products.

Continuous Improver: Whether it’s cutting latency by 70 % with event-driven workflows or boosting test coverage past 90 %, I measure, iterate, and leave every codebase better than I found it.

Tech Stack Snapshot: Java • Node.js • Python • AWS (IAM, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB) • Spring Boot • Express • Terraform • GitLab CI/CD • Grafana • MongoDB • Oracle

When I’m not refactoring or automating something, you’ll catch me exploring Florida with my family or turning our Disney visits into learning adventures.

Let’s connect if you need a developer who thinks like an architect, codes like a craftsman, and mentors like a partner, always with the end user (and the business) in mind.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer III focused on modernizing enterprise Mortgage Warehouse Lending technology through .NET development, CI/CD automation, platform engineering, security, and production reliability.

### Key Contributions
- Modernize legacy .NET and Windows applications through CI/CD, infrastructure upgrades, deployment automation, API integration, and platform improvements.
- Migrated legacy Windows deployments to GitLab CI/CD with environment-specific deployment and rollback workflows across DEV, ITE, TPP, and production.
- Build PowerShell automation for deployments, validation, diagnostics, remediation, and Windows Server application management.
- Troubleshoot distributed systems spanning .NET services, IIS, SQL Server, REST APIs, authentication, certificates, and enterprise integrations.
- Support Windows Server migrations, configuration management, environment validation, and production readiness.
- Deliver security improvements involving TLS, certificate authentication, vulnerability remediation, and service identities.
- Apply dependency analysis, dry runs, validation, and rollback planning to reduce risk during application and data changes.
- Improve engineering quality through peer review, testing, root-cause analysis, release validation, and deployment standardization.
- Partner with engineering, QA, infrastructure, database, middleware, security, and business teams on complex modernization initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microsoft SQL Server · API Development · Release Management · Agile Methodologies · Risk Management · Systems Modernization · Cross-Functional Collaboration · Software Engineering · AI-Assisted Development · Software Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led front-end architecture redesign for internal American Football content platforms using Angular and React, reducing load times by 40%.
 • Developed internal microservices in Node.js and C# to streamline asset workflows across 5+ cross-functional teams.
 • Designed and deployed CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab, reducing deployment effort by 80%.
 • Built Grafana dashboards for platform health monitoring, supporting live operations across global teams.
 • Mentored 4 junior developers and led over 100 code reviews to ensure code quality and best practices.
 • Served as technical lead for multiple cross-functional projects involving Game Core Engineering, EA Data Platform, and Dev Ops.
 • Created internal onboarding documentation and training, reducing onboarding time by 30%.
 • Engineered backend services in Java to power EA's live services content management systems, enabling scalable, real-time asset publishing.
 • Built Scala-based APIs and ingestion tools to support dynamic content delivery pipelines for games and live events.
 • Integrated JVM-based infrastructure with EA's broader platform, collaborating with data, infra, and game teams to ensure end-to-end reliability.
 • Integrated AWS SSM Parameter Store & Secrets Manager across all JVM services, eliminating plaintext credentials and passing SOC2 audit with zero critical findings.
 • Implemented CloudWatch Logs Insights and Grafana dashboards to monitor code changes, identifying regression spikes within 10 minutes and preventing three potential Sev-1 outages in 2024
 • Automated packaging and promotion via dotnet-CLI and GitLab CI, publishing versioned NuGet packages to an internal feed and reducing release lead-time by 65 percent
 • Introduced xUnit + Moq unit-test suites (1,200 tests, 92% coverage) across all C# repositories, facilitating weekly releases and catching three production-blocking regressions pre-merge

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Angular/C#.NET tools to automate reporting, enhancing efficiency in data processing
 • Created Java desktop apps for supply chain analytics, improving data analysis capabilities
 • Contributed to Razor MVC architecture and API design, facilitating seamless integration and functionality
 • Managed end-to-end app development for key business units, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals
 • Re-architected a monolithic merchandise-planning engine into six Spring Boot microservices running on AWS ECS, cutting nightly batch runtimes by 45 % and enabling independent feature deployments.
 • Built Java REST APIs behind API Gateway + Lambda to surface real-time logistics positions to sourcing specialists' mobile apps, trimming integration onboarding time for new sourcing contracts from 3 weeks to 5 days.
 • Implemented Zipkin distributed tracing in Java services, providing merch-ops dashboards with detailed request latency breakdowns, which contributed to a 30% reduction in mean latency, enhancing supply-chain efficiency during peak periods
 • Built Razor Pages dashboards in ASP.NET Core for planners to visualize live sourcing positions, replacing static Excel workbooks and saving ~12 analyst-hours per week.

positions.title: UX Design Intern
positions.description:
•	Participate in information architecture, interaction design, visual design work, and the user design process.
•	Use graphic design packages such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Dreamweaver in order to produce basic layout and manipulate images.
•	Understand and incorporate technical, business and user requirements into designs
•	Accelerated use of graphic design packages such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Dreamweaver to produce basic layout and manipulate images 
•	Troubleshoot and develop Java web interfaces that integrate resort hotels client information and reservation systems 
•	Collaborate with designers to create clean interfaces and simple, intuitive interactions and experiences 
•	Used Agile development methodology for maximum flexibility with changing stakeholder’s requirement

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Web development using PHP/CSS/HTML/JavaScript/FTP for websites based on priority and direction.  
•	Creating the information architecture and interaction design for transactional/e-commerce, informational, and marketing websites.
•	Collaborate with Web Designers and on all web development.
•	Participate in brainstorming and concept development.
•	Contacted clients to obtain more information and discuss design options 
•	Facilitated full stack web development on LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP) stack with JQuery based on priority and direction 
•	Created the information architecture and interaction design for transactional/e-commerce, informational, and marketing websites with WordPress and Magento content management systems 
•	Oversaw scheduling of project milestones and coordinated with clients on any proposed changes or challenges to be overcome 
•	Integrate PayPal Payments REST API to easily and securely accept online and mobile payments
